summary: The fixture Axo app validates its bundled app-to-daemon RPC and terminal-attach contract against an isolated axod without changing LaunchAgent registration.
trigger: The test host is launched with --self-test and AXO_SELF_TEST_SOCKET pointing to an isolated daemon.

steps.action: Check daemon health and require exactly one initial default Session; create a test Session and verify its PTY shell using the bundled axod terminal-attach helper.
Create two additional shells, verify the exact pane set and ensure unrelated baseline Sessions remain unchanged.
Close middle/first shells without archiving the Session, close baseline Sessions independently, then close the last pane and require a new replacement Session.
Emit AXO_SELF_TEST_OK and exit zero on success; emit a diagnostic marker and exit nonzero on any contract or PTY output failure.
